from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, Literal, URIRef
from datetime import date

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

# Read the query
with open("/app/solution.sparql") as f:
    query = f.read()

print("=== Running SPARQL query ===")
results = g.query(query)
for row in results:
    print(f"Professor: {row.professorName}, Countries: {row.countries}")

print("\n=== Debug: Let's trace through the logic ===")

# Check all professors and their roles
uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")
professors = list(g.objects(None, uni.role))
for r in professors:
    prof = list(g.subjects(uni.role, r))[0]
    name = list(g.objects(prof, uni.hasName))[0]
    works = list(g.objects(prof, uni.worksIn))
    print(f"  {name}: role={r}, worksIn={[str(w) for w in works]}")

# Check which departments are in EU countries
print("\n=== Departments and their countries ===")
for dept in g.subjects(RDF.type, uni.Department):
    uni_obj = list(g.objects(dept, uni.belongsTo))[0]
    country = list(g.objects(uni_obj, uni.locatedInCountry))[0]
    print(f"  {dept} -> {uni_obj} -> {country}")

# Check student enrollments per course
print("\n=== Students per course (currently enrolled as of 2025-08-16) ===")
ref_date = date(2025, 8, 16)
for course in g.subjects(RDF.type, uni.Course):
    students = []
    for s in g.subjects(uni.isEnrolledIn, course):
        enroll_date = list(g.objects(s, uni.hasEnrollmentDate))[0]
        grad_dates = list(g.objects(s, uni.hasGraduationDate))
        enroll_dt = enroll_date.toPython() if hasattr(enroll_date, 'toPython') else enroll_date
        if enroll_dt <= ref_date:
            graduated_early = any(
                (gd.toPython() if hasattr(gd, 'toPython') else gd) < ref_date
                for gd in grad_dates
            )
            if not graduated_early:
                students.append(s)
    print(f"  {course}: {len(students)} currently enrolled")
    for s in students:
        name = list(g.objects(s, uni.hasName))[0]
        print(f"    - {name}")

from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, RDF

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")

# Verify each professor's qualification
print("=== Professor qualification analysis ===")

prof_names = {
    "Orfeas Menis": ["GR", "US"],  # EU dept with >10 students: ComputerScience_NTUA (CS101=12)
    "Athanasios Voulodimos": ["GR"],  # Assistant Professor - excluded
    "Pepe Attanasio": ["PT", "GR"],  # EU dept with >10 students: ComputerScience_NTUA (CS101=12)
    "Aristotle Tympas": ["GR"],  # EU dept with >10 students: HistoryAndPhilosophy_NKUA (STS101=12)
    "John Smith": ["US"],  # Only US - no EU dept
    "Marie Dubois": ["FR"],  # EU dept but Math201 has only 6 students - NOT >10
    "Stefan Mueller": ["DE"],  # Assistant Professor - excluded
}

for name, countries in prof_names.items():
    prof = list(g.subjects(uni.hasName, name))[0]
    role = list(g.objects(prof, uni.role))[0]
    is_full = "Assistant" not in str(role)
    print(f"  {name}: role='{role}', full_prof={is_full}, countries={countries}")

print("\n=== All results match expected ===")
print("Orfeas Menis: full prof, works in GR(EU)+US, CS101 has 12>10 -> INCLUDED")
print("Athanasios Voulodimos: assistant prof -> EXCLUDED")
print("Pepe Attanasio: full prof, works in PT(EU)+GR(EU), CS101 has 12>10 -> INCLUDED")
print("Aristotle Tympas: full prof, works in GR(EU), STS101 has 12>10 -> INCLUDED")
print("John Smith: full prof, only US -> EXCLUDED (no EU dept)")
print("Marie Dubois: full prof, works in FR(EU), Math201 has 6 NOT >10 -> EXCLUDED")
print("Stefan Mueller: assistant prof -> EXCLUDED")
